description: Automated multi-agent pipeline. v4.6.1 (Slice 3b correction): reverts unified single-skill-with-mode-flag pattern to 2 separate skills (feature-light + feature-heavy) mirroring Pulsar canonical Heavy/ + Ligth/ folders 1:1. Same pattern as Slice 1.5 (bugfix) + Slice 3a (audit). v4.6.0 attempted unification but was reverted per dono — fonte canônica tem 2 pastas, port deve ter 2 skills. v4.6.0 (Slice 3b initial): imports prescriptive 13-step Pulsar Implement_new_feature workflow. v4.5.0 (Slice 3a): imports prescriptive 9-step Heavy + 9-step Light audit workflows from Pulsar as backing skills (audit-light, audit-heavy); /audit dispatches via --light/--heavy flags or auto-classify; report-only by Iron Law (no production writes); reuses existing audit-{intake,domain-analyzer,compliance-checker,risk-matrix-generator} agents; 8 enforcement rules + read-only invariant. v4.4.1 fix: deterministic Node wrapper for exec-window (scripts/exec-window/{open,close}.cjs) eliminates PIPELINE_LOCK_ACTIVE stalls. v4.4.0 (Slice 1.5): imports prescriptive 11-step Heavy + 8-step Light bugfix workflows from Pulsar as backing skills (bugfix-light, bugfix-heavy); /bugfix dispatches via --light/--heavy flags or auto-classify; closes 6 audit gaps (Heavy 3+9+11, Light 3+5+6) with 8 enforcement rules. v4.3.1 polish: review-driven cleanup of v4.3.0 skill migration. v4.3.0: /bugfix migrated commands/ → skills/ per official docs. v4.2.x: SEC patches + thin entry-points. v4 base: orchestration in isolated controller agent.
